purpose: Teach: 特製/作風/家系/ごっこ/島国/走り出し/七つ/遠回り

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、特製レシピと地域文化、興味深いですね。
lines.en: Your paper on special recipes and regional culture—it's fascinating.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested. Leans forward slightly. Open tone inviting him to expand. Steady eye contact, like she's really listening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。作風の継承、世代を跨いで論じました。
lines.en: Yes. I traced how culinary style gets passed down across generations.
lines.style: Careful, measured. Takes a breath before speaking, like he's chosen each word. Quiet pride underneath the modesty. Slightly tentative—checking if she's following.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 家系図と料理伝承、独自の章ですね。
lines.en: The family tree section paired with culinary transmission—that's your original contribution, isn't it.
lines.style: Recognition in the voice. Thoughtful pace. Not a question exactly, more a confirmation of something she's spotted. Encouraging without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 子供の頃のごっこ遊び、文化心理学の視点で扱いました。
lines.en: I looked at childhood play-acting through a cultural-psychology lens—how kids inherit without knowing it.
lines.style: Slight hesitation at the start, then gains confidence. Soft intensity building. He's explaining something he genuinely believes matters. Slight lean into the importance of it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 島国としての日本の食、ユニークですね。
lines.en: Island Japan's approach to food—there's something distinct about that.
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. Slightly slower pace. She's thinking out loud with him, not at him. Genuine curiosity pulling the words forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 若手研究者、走り出した運動、章末に紹介します。
lines.en: There's a movement happening with younger researchers right now. I introduce it at the end of the chapter.
lines.style: Slight energy shift—something he's excited about. More direct than before. Not quite breathless, but there's forward momentum. The confidence of someone who knows this matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 参考文献、七つの古典、入れましたね。
lines.en: And your references—you've got seven foundational texts in there.
lines.style: Approving nod in the voice. Noticing the work underneath. Not overpraising, just—seeing it. Steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 結論、遠回りせず、直球で書きました。
lines.en: The conclusion doesn't circle around. I wrote it straight.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. No apology, no hedging. Like he's made a choice and stood by it. Small but firm. Breath steady.
